connector.name: MAL MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MyAnimeList MCP server: Tenrai-powered reads plus official MAL personal-list management.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mal-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grinv account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MAL_CLIENT_ID
env.description: MAL app Client ID (type 'other'). Also enables read-tool resilience with no login. See docs/auth.md.

env.name: MAL_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: OAuth refresh token (one-time auth, docs/auth.md); enables personal-list tools with auto-refresh.

env.name: MAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Advanced: standalone MAL access token. Works ~30 days without refresh; usually leave unset.
